mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and restrictive policy (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) creates stagflation, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) triggers accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 7.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Month-over-month growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 500.0 thousand units signal weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0) signals recessionary conditions that prompt rate cuts, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak consumer demand (RSAFS < 350000 million dollars) combined with industrial contraction (INDPRO < 95.0) indicates deepening slowdown, triggering policy stimulus that boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS < 350000 and INDPRO < 95.0, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.
